description: Risk of serotonin syndrome and CNS toxicity. Avoid concurrent administration.
Concurrent NSAID use increases risk of severe GI ulceration and bleeding.
Risk of contrast-induced nephropathy and lactic acidosis. Withhold metformin 48h prior.
Penicillins reduce renal clearance of methotrexate, increasing toxic risk.
Significant elevation in statin plasma levels; high risk of rhabdomyolysis.
Chelation with polyvalent cations severely impairs ciprofloxacin absorption.
